source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    templates = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        values = [v for v in row if v != 0]
        if len(values) > 1:
            templates.append((r, values))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        points = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
        if len(points) != 1 or any(r == tr for tr, _ in templates):
            continue
        c = points[0]
        color = row[c]
        matches = [(tr, seq) for tr, seq in templates if color in seq]
        if not matches:
            continue

        _, seq = min(matches, key=lambda item: abs(item[0] - r))
        start = c - seq.index(color)
        for j, value in enumerate(seq):
            col = start + j
            if 0 <= col < w:
                out[r][col] = value
    return out
'''
